text:
Under-eye bags, tear troughs, and malar bags are not the same thing — but because they're so close together, they can visually exaggerate each other.
That’s why I don’t recommend focusing only on the area directly under your eyes.
The mid-cheek, eye area, temples, forehead, and even the scalp all work together. Releasing tension through the surrounding fascia can help create a softer, smoother transition from the under-eye into the cheek.
